business_problem: DXC needed to reduce insurance document backlogs and automate highly regulated underwriting and claims decisions without losing auditability, policy fidelity, or human oversight.
solution_summary: DXC built Assure, an orchestration layer on the Claude Platform, to insert Claude into every layer of its insurance software portfolio. Claims submissions and policy documents arrive from email, fax, paper, phone, and OCR processes, then Claude classifies and reasons over them, including hundred-page commercial claims files. Assure keeps every action logged, traceable, and replayable for regulators, and routes work across model tiers so frontier models are reserved for the hardest files. DXC also uses Claude to encode new regulations and decision logic into purpose-built Smart Apps, such as a workers' compensation weekly earnings calculator that combines legislation, documented rules, system algorithms, and DXC calculators. Because Assure is API-driven and tied to DXC's existing platforms, carriers can connect without custom setups while keeping compliance and governance built into the flow.

data_flow: Submissions and claims arrive through email, fax, paper, phone, and OCR channels, Assure routes them to Claude for classification and reasoning, Smart Apps apply insurance logic or regulatory calculations, and every action is logged so carriers and regulators can replay the decision path end to end.
business_outcome: DXC cut claims-document backlogs from days to minutes, classified documents in under a second, embedded new regulatory rules in days instead of 12 to 18 months, and stood up a regulated benefits calculation in eight hours that was 80 percent right on the first pass.
